name: The Home Depot® Consumer Credit Card
network: PROPRIETARY (Home Depot / Citi Retail Services, closed-loop, not Visa or Mastercard)
effective_cost: Free, with no annual fee, but purely a store-financing tool with no rewards and no use outside Home Depot

welcome_bonus.requirement: qualifying purchases when opening a new account; exact terms and tiers vary by promotion

verdict.text: A financing card, not rewards: for Home Depot buys you can pay off in time

earn_note: This card has no cash-back or points program of any kind. Its entire value proposition is deferred-interest financing ("no interest if paid in full within the promotional period") on Home Depot purchases, plus an extended return window. If you want rewards for home-improvement spend, a general-purpose card with a home-improvement or everyday-purchases category will out-earn this every time.

points.note: No points or cash back exist on this card. Its value is deferred-interest financing: 6 months on purchases of $299 or more, and up to 24 months during special promotions. If the balance isn't paid in full by the deadline, interest is charged back to the purchase date at the card's 29.99% APR, which is a real risk if you carry a balance past the promo window.

transfer_partners.highlight: No rewards currency exists on this card, so there is nothing to transfer.

protection_note: None of the usual card protections apply: this is a closed-loop retail financing account, not a Visa or Mastercard, so there's no purchase protection, extended warranty, or travel insurance. Citi lists $0 liability on unauthorized charges, a Fraud Protection Guarantee and fraud alerts.
rental_note: No rental car coverage; this card can't be used for rentals or anywhere outside Home Depot and homedepot.com.

services.name: Deferred-interest project financing
services.detail: 6 months no-interest financing on purchases of $299+ if paid in full within the promo window; special promotions extend this up to 24 months at times. Missing the deadline triggers retroactive interest back to the purchase date.

services.name: Extended return window
services.detail: Cardholders get 1 year to make returns, four times Home Depot's standard window, subject to Home Depot's Returns Policy.

services.name: Flexible due date
services.detail: Choose a payment due date at the beginning, middle, or end of the month.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users
additional_cards.note: Citi lists authorized users as a feature of this card but does not publish the terms on its product page.

timeline.text: No rewards program: the card's value comes entirely from deferred-interest financing on qualifying Home Depot purchases, not from earning anything back.
